name: Printed-part inspection and photography bench
family: Electronics, additive manufacturing and DIY workspaces
description: Printed-part inspection and photography bench is a conceptual setting for layer-quality review; prototype documentation. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
scope: Finite original context geometry, a separate HDR/EXR illumination field and a camera-only authored backplate. Sun energy is kept outside the HDR to prevent duplicate solar illumination.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft modelling/product viewport snapshot. It does not apply the saved HDR/path-traced lighting.
limitations: Procedural family realization with named contextual components; no claim that every physical detail of the concept has been modeled or validated.
Native glTF import retains geometry and scalar appearances, not arbitrary material extensions or textures.
